messages.subject: Coordinates for a bar chart
parts:
Hi,

In R's base graphs, we can get and use the coordinates of a bar chart by
using, say,

z <- barplot(x, horiz = TRUE)

I often use these coordinates to add extra text on the same line of each
bar. So, for example, I can do something like

text(x+0.05, z, "vector of text")

How can I do this in ggplot2?

Thanks,

Walt
